feature_description: Review a draft feature proposal for exporting release readiness data to CSV. The draft story says: As a program manager, I want to export the filtered dashboard view to CSV so I can share release status updates without manually copying data. The current idea includes a dashboard export action, permission-aware row selection, audit logging, and a user-friendly failure message if the export cannot be generated. The draft is not final yet and should be treated as a review-oriented request.
